conservation.condition_narrative: There are numerous creases overall, most prominently at the corners and the right center edge. The lower right is slightly curled upward. Printing from the verso is visible on the recto. There are inclusions in the paper, support, and stray media. There is a repaired delaminated/folded corner on the bottom right of the verso (lower left corner when viewed from recto). The work is complete. The support and media are secure. The work is evenly colored. There are inclusions in the paper and stray media marks. The work is mostly planar. There are numerous creases in the corners, edges, and overall. The lower right is slightly curled upward. A delaminated area on the verso was repaired on the bottom right of the verso (lower left corner when viewed from recto).
conservation.technical_description:
**Support:** The support is smooth, medium-weight, cream-colored woven paper with straight edges and printing on the verso. 
 
 
 
**Design Layers:** Black ink, possibly from a ballpoint pen. 
 
 
 
**Surface Coating:** None.
